description: Has the submission deadline of an EU tender moved? For a tender watched by Aurelmark (an independent service tracking official TED contract notices), returns per-LOT previous deadline versus revised deadline, with both official TED notice references and links, plus the current deadlines per lot and freshness. The answer carries an explicit status: not_covered (never watched -- NOT proof the deadline stands), covered_no_change_recorded (watched, unchanged since monitoring began), change_recorded, change_recorded_lot_unresolved, quota_exhausted or source_stale (no answer obtained). Coverage is small and enrolment is by request: most tenders are not watched. Use the tender's FIRST notice number in TED form, e.g. 662865-2026. For searching tenders use ted-eu; this is the change feed.

cursor.description: Optional more_events_cursor from an earlier response, to page further events.

notice_id.description: TED publication number of the tender's first notice, e.g. "662865-2026" (a ted.europa.eu notice URL is also accepted).

name: aurelmark_ted_changes
